description: Header file defining the ParameterDictImpl class, a container for managing a collection of named tensors (parameters) in the PyTorch C++ API, including methods for insertion, removal, iteration, and access.

classes.name: ParameterDictImpl
classes.description: Implementation class for a parameter dictionary managing named tensors, supporting insertion, deletion, iteration, and access operations.

methods.name: ParameterDictImpl
methods.description: Default constructor for ParameterDictImpl.

methods.name: ParameterDictImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing ParameterDictImpl with an existing ordered dictionary of parameters.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Empty method; does not reset parameters.

methods.name: pretty_print
methods.description: Prints the contents of the ParameterDict to an output stream.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a parameter with a key into the dictionary, setting requires_grad to true by default.

methods.name: pop
methods.description: Removes a parameter by key and returns its tensor.

methods.name: keys
methods.description: Returns a vector of all keys.

methods.name: values
methods.description: Returns a vector of all tensor values.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the start of the parameters.

methods.name: begin (const)
methods.description: Returns a const iterator to the start of the parameters.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the parameters.

methods.name: end (const)
methods.description: Returns a const iterator to the end of the parameters.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns the number of parameters stored.

methods.name: empty
methods.description: Checks if the dictionary is empty.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the dictionary with key-value pairs from another container.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all parameters.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if a key exists in the dictionary.

methods.name: get (const)
methods.description: Returns the tensor associated with a key, throws if key not found.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the tensor associated with a key, throws if key not found.

methods.name: operator[]
methods.description: Accesses the tensor by key, throws if key not found.
